verdicts.reason: A: the one-line headline runs right into the CTA ('last' nearly touches the button), the CTA is jammed against the right edge, the 'Longest Day Sale' banner has shrunk to a tiny tag stuck under the legal line, and the fine print is almost as large as the subhead. B: the two-line headline, the CTA and the bottle sit in clear columns with room to breathe, but the logo is shrunk to near-illegible size, the sale tag floats loosely beside the headline, the oversized CTA competes with the headline, and the legal line sits tight to the bottom edge.
